comment: Trust anchor for the AttestArc knowledge plane. In bootstrap mode the packs are trusted by virtue of shipping inside the SSH-signed skill release; per-role threshold signatures are established by the first signed knowledge release (.github/workflows/release-knowledge.yml, M5), at which point 'mode' becomes 'signed' and 'keys'/'roles' carry maintainer allowed-signer public keys. The signature namespace is 'attestarc-knowledge'.
